tagline: Guidewire is the platform that property and casualty (P&C) insurers rely on to engage with customers, innovate, and operate more efficiently.
hero_kpi_rationale: Guidewire positions itself as a cloud platform provider for insurers, with a strong component of recurring revenue (ARR), which is a key indicator of revenue stability and predictability in the software sector.

kpis.name: Service and subscription revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from cloud subscription services and products delivered via the cloud.
kpis.description: Represents revenue from subscriptions to the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) and related products.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring revenue, a driver of valuation.

kpis.name: Non-GAAP gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, excluding stock-based compensation and amortization of intangible assets.
kpis.description: Gross margin calculated on a non-GAAP basis, excluding stock-based compensation and amortization of intangible assets.

kpis.name: Non-GAAP operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit in absolute value on a non-GAAP basis.
kpis.description: Operating margin calculated on a non-GAAP basis, excluding stock-based compensation, amortization of intangible assets, and other items.

kpis.name: Cash, cash equivalents, and investments
kpis.description: Total amount of cash, cash equivalents, and liquid investments consisting of corporate debt securities, government securities, and commercial paper.

kpis.name: Working capital
kpis.explanation: Current assets minus current liabilities, an indicator of the ability to fund ongoing operations.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to fund its ongoing operations and increased due to proceeds from convertible debt issuance and positive operating cash flows.
kpis.signal: Major improvement in working capital following the issuance of convertible bonds.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 2.72 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Share of cloud offerings incorporating AI
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud transactions that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: Indicator of customer adoption of AI capabilities within their cloud solutions. Not disclosed in the provided 10-K.

kpis.name: AI API call volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of calls made to artificial intelligence-related application programming interfaces.
kpis.description: Measures customer usage of AI services, indicating growing adoption. Not disclosed in the provided 10-K.

risks.title: Quarterly fluctuations
risks.summary: Quarterly results may fluctuate significantly due to external factors and seasonality, which could impact the stock price
risks.score_rationale: Variability in quarterly results due to external factors such as economic conditions and customer behavior, as well as seasonality in billing and commission cycles (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on a limited number of large customers for a significant portion of its ARR and revenue
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on a small number of customers for a large portion of revenue and ARR, giving these customers substantial negotiating power (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Long sales cycles
risks.summary: Extended sales cycles require in-depth evaluations and customer references, potentially leading to significant expenses before revenue generation
risks.score_rationale: Long and variable sales cycles for acquiring new customers, especially for migrations to GWCP, with uncontrollable factors such as competitive pressures (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.summary: The company faces intense competition that could impact its market share, margins, and financial results
risks.score_rationale: Intense competition in the P&C insurance software market, with various competitors depending on product line and geography (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Data security and privacy
risks.summary: The company is exposed to data security and privacy breach risks that could impact its reputation, expose it to legal liability, and affect financial results
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to data security and privacy breach risks affecting sensitive data of insurers and their customers (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: AI integration and adoption
risks.summary: The company must develop and deploy AI effectively to remain competitive, while complying with emerging regulations
risks.score_rationale: Need to develop and integrate AI effectively into the platform while managing an uncertain regulatory environment and customer acceptance (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical and regulatory risks
risks.summary: Regional conflicts, political changes, and regulatory developments could impact international operations and financial results
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to geopolitical risks, regulatory changes in the insurance sector, and international regulatory disparities (default score, to be refined)
